key.name: login-server
key.description: If you are using Headscale for your control server, use your Headscale instance's URL.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often the panel refreshes tailnet state while the extension is enabled. 0 disables periodic polling; the menu still refreshes when opened.

key.name: auto-copy-node-address
key.summary: Notify after copying a node address
key.description: Clicking a node always copies its address; with this enabled a desktop notification confirms the copy.

key.name: socket-path
key.description: Path of the tailscaled unix socket. Override for non-standard installs (some distros or user-mode tailscaled use a different path).
